Canonical package areas:
- api/: external surface
- cli/: entrypoints
- config/: presets/defaults
- platform/: shared mechanics
- features/: chart, layer, and tabular-input slices

Authoring defaults:
- New chart: add one slice under features/charts/<chart> and one targeted test
- New reusable visual capability: add one slice under features/layers/<layer>
- Avoid central dispatch edits; rely on registry autodiscovery
- Prefer explicit, local logic over hidden indirection

Primary docs:
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- AGENTS.md
- .agents/skills/add-new-chart/SKILL.md
